items.title: FirstEnergy (FE) Q3 Results Contrast EPS Growth With Margin Strain
items.summary: FirstEnergy shares barely budged after the Q3 2026 release, ticking up about 0.3% to US$46.40. For a regulated electric utility, that kind of muted move can look like a shrug. The headline story is less sleepy. Core earnings per share landed at US$0.98 for the quarter, and management kept full year core EPS guidance of US$2.62 to US$2.82 on the table.
